newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's BTC plunges five percent.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's BTC plunges five percent.

text.p: Shares in Slovenian shopping centre operator BTC plunged five percent on Monday morning after a successful GDR issue failed to prevent a sell-off, traders said.

"Expectations were high as many believed BTC will soar once GDRs are issued. However, that did not come true, therefore some are moving out in order to look for a more profitable short-term investment," one trader said.
By 0820 GMT, BTC had lost five percent to 13,300 tolars on volume of 412 shares.
Since Tuesday, when BTC announced its global depositary receipt issue was six times oversubscribed, its shares have fallen 5.8 percent.
"Because there will be no arbitrage between the London price of GDRs and the Ljubljana price of shares for at least six months, GDRs have a limited influence on BTC's share price," the trader said.
But he said BTC may have bottomed out as its major shareholders are likely to defend the price at the current level. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 156.1 Slovenian Tolars)
